title: Learning Self-Orchestration in Decentralized Agent Swarms
title_zh: MPT (Market-based Post-training) Framework for Self-Organizing Learning in Decentralized Agent Groups

paragraphs.en: The capabilities of an agent swarm depend on both its individual members and how they coordinate. Yet existing multi-agent systems often train agents within fixed orchestration structures, separating the learning of individual capabilities from the organization of collective behavior. We introduce market-based post-training ( MPT ), a framework for jointly learning action policies and self-orchestration in decentralized agent swarms. Agents express their willingness to participate through bids, which determine who acts and how collective outcomes provide local training credit. Learning both action and bidding behavior allows individual capabilities and patterns of participation to adapt together without a central coordinating agent. We evaluate MPT on embodied crafting, robot navigation, and deep research. Results show gains over monolithic post-training and confirm that agent participation indeed evolves with learning. With the same post-trained action policies, learned self-orchestration outperforms alternative coordination strategies. Ablations show that both action and bidding benefit from learning, and that learned bids provide more effective action-training signals. Beyond the original training objectives, trained swarms adapt faster to related tasks and achieve better performance with larger populations at inference time. Larger populations also suffer smaller performance losses under agent dropout, demonstrating that learned self-orchestration supports reuse, scaling, and robustness in decentralized agent swarms. Code and trained models are available at https://github.com/Embodied-Minds-Lab/MPT .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体群的能力既取决于其个体成员，也取决于它们之间的协调方式。 然而，现有的多智能体系统通常是在固定的协调结构中训练智能体，将个体能力的学习与集体行为的组织分离开来。 我们提出了基于市场的后训练（MPT），这是一种在去中心化智能体群中联合学习行动策略和自我协调的框架。 智能体通过出价表达其参与意愿，这决定了谁执行行动以及集体成果如何提供局部训练信用。 同时学习行动和出价行为，使得个体能力和参与模式能够协同适应，而无需中央协调智能体。 我们在具身制造、机器人导航和深度研究任务上对 MPT 进行了评估。 结果表明，MPT 相较于整体式后训练方法表现更优，并证实了智能体的参与确实会随着学习而演变。 在使用相同的后训练行动策略时，所学习的自我协调策略优于其他替代的协调策略。 消融实验表明，行动和出价行为都受益于学习过程，且学习后的出价能提供更有效的行动训练信号。 除了原始的训练目标外，经过训练的智能体群能更快地适应相关任务，并在推理阶段随着群体规模的扩大而取得更好的性能。 在智能体脱落的情况下，更大的群体规模带来的性能损失也更小，这表明所学习的自我协调策略支持了去中心化智能体群的复用、扩展和鲁棒性。 代码和训练好的模型可在 https://github.com/Embodied-Minds-Lab/MPT 获取。

paragraphs.en: Building general intelligence has long been a central ambition of AI research. But where does intelligence reside? A prevailing view in modern AI is model-centric: intelligence is contained in the parameters of a model, and progress comes from increasing model size or improving those parameters through training. In this paper, we explore a different possibility. Intelligent behavior can also emerge from interactions among many simpler agents, giving rise to collective capabilities that no single agent possesses. This perspective echoes Minsky’s Society of Mind ( Minsky, 1986 ) , which explains intelligence through the organization and interaction of many individually limited components.

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents now exhibit strong individual reasoning capabilities, yet agent swarms remain limited in their ability to organize their own participation and actions toward a shared objective. Existing multi-agent systems typically place models within predefined interaction structures: a manager delegates to workers, a verifier checks a generator, or agents communicate according to a prescribed workflow ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) . Even when the participating agents are trainable, the orchestration policy that determines which agent acts next often remains fixed throughout training ( Feng et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体如今展现出强大的个体推理能力，但智能体群在组织自身参与和行动以达成共同目标方面仍存在局限。 现有的多智能体系统通常将模型置于预定义的交互结构中：管理者向执行者分配任务，验证者检查生成者的输出，或智能体按照预设的工作流程进行通信（Hong et al., 2024 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2024）。 即使参与的智能体本身可训练，但决定哪个智能体下一步行动的协调策略在整个训练过程中往往保持不变（Feng et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Can decentralized agent swarms jointly learn to act and self-orchestrate from experience?
paragraphs.zh: 去中心化的智能体群能否从经验中共同学习行动并实现自我协调？

paragraphs.en: Learning self-orchestration in decentralized agent swarms poses a joint orchestration and credit-assignment problem. At each turn, agents must determine who should act. When task feedback becomes available, the swarm must also determine how to train the agents whose actions shaped the trajectory. These decisions are coupled: participation determines which agents acquire experience, while learning changes which and how agents should participate in the future.
paragraphs.zh: 在去中心化的智能体群体中学习自我协调，会引发一个联合协调与信用分配问题。 在每个回合中，智能体必须决定由谁来执行行动。 当任务反馈可用时，该群体还必须确定如何训练那些其行动塑造了任务轨迹的智能体。 这些决策是相互耦合的：参与决定了哪些智能体能获得经验，而学习过程则会改变未来哪些智能体以及如何参与。

paragraphs.en: We therefore introduce market-based post-training ( MPT ), a framework that enables decentralized agent swarms to learn both how to act and how to self-organize their participation. Following Qi et al. (2026) , agents compete for opportunities to act through bids that reflect their willingness to participate in the current decision. An economic incentive structure connects these participation decisions with credit assignment, using collective outcomes to improve both action and bidding behavior. As agents become more capable, the swarm learns when to rely on each member, allowing individual capabilities and self-orchestration to evolve together without a central coordinating agent.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate MPT on embodied crafting, robot navigation, and deep research. Comparisons on these benchmarks show higher training rewards than monolithic post-training, while further analysis reveals that agent participation evolves during learning. To isolate the contribution of self-orchestration, we compare coordination strategies using the same post-trained action policies. On Iron Pickaxe, MPT achieves a 63.4% relative improvement in mean episode reward over the strongest alternative, Graph-of-Agents. We further show that both bidding and action benefit from learning, with their joint use yielding the strongest performance. A credit-assignment ablation shows that learned bids also provide more effective action-training signals.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在具身制造、机器人导航和深度研究任务上对 MPT 进行了评估。 在这些基准测试上的对比显示，MPT 的训练奖励高于单一模型的后训练方法，而进一步分析表明，智能体的参与方式在学习过程中会发生变化。 为了分离自我协调机制的贡献，我们使用相同的后训练动作策略比较了不同的协作策略。 在 Iron Pickaxe 任务中，MPT 的平均回合奖励相比最强的替代方案 Graph-of-Agents 实现了 63.4% 的相对提升。 我们还进一步证明，出价和动作都受益于学习过程，而两者的联合使用带来了最强的性能表现。 信用分配消融分析表明，学习到的出价也能提供更有效的动作训练信号。

paragraphs.en: We also examine the reusability, scalability, and robustness of MPT . Trained swarms adapt more rapidly than the single-agent baseline to new crafting objectives. Increasing the inference-time population improves pass@3 across crafting milestones without additional training, supporting the scalability of learned self-orchestration. Larger populations also better tolerate occasional agent unavailability. These results suggest that learned self-orchestration supports both reuse across objectives and flexible deployment with varying agent populations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还研究了 MPT 的可重用性、可扩展性和鲁棒性。 经过训练的群体比单智能体基线模型能更快地适应新的制造目标。 增加推理时的群体规模可以在无需额外训练的情况下，提升各个制造里程碑的 pass@3 指标，从而支持所学习到的自我协调机制的可扩展性。 更大的群体也能更好地容忍智能体偶尔无法使用的情况。 这些结果表明，所学习到的自我协调机制既支持跨不同目标的重用，也支持在智能体规模变化时的灵活部署。

paragraphs.en: We aim to jointly learn specialized action policies and self-orchestration in decentralized agent swarms. Each agent uses its local context to decide how strongly to participate through bidding. Bids determine both which agent acts and how task rewards are allocated across participating agents for learning. We first describe this orchestration mechanism (§ 2.1 ), then explain how agents learn to act from the resulting credit (§ 2.2 ) and learn to bid through counterfactual comparisons (§ 2.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的目标是联合学习去中心化智能体群体中的专用动作策略和自我编排能力。 每个智能体利用其局部上下文，通过竞价决定参与强度。 竞价既决定了哪个智能体执行动作，也决定了任务奖励如何在参与学习的智能体之间分配。 我们首先描述这种编排机制（§ 2.1），然后解释智能体如何从由此产生的回报中学习行动（§ 2.2），以及如何通过反事实比较学习竞价（§ 2.3）。

paragraphs.en: Following Qi et al. (2026) , we adopt an auction mechanism for decentralized turn allocation. At each turn, agents independently submit bids b i b_{i} reflecting their willingness to participate in the current decision. The agent with the highest bid is selected to act, and its bid is denoted by b t b_{t} . This allows participation to depend on the agents’ local assessments without a central dispatcher. Tied bids are broken uniformly at random. If all agents bid zero, no agent acts and the turn is skipped.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 Qi 等人（2026）的研究，我们采用一种拍卖机制来实现去中心化的回合分配。在每个回合中，智能体独立提交出价 b i b_{i}，以反映其参与当前决策的意愿。出价最高的智能体将被选中执行行动，其出价表示为 b t b_{t}。这样，参与决策可以基于智能体的局部评估，而无需中央调度器。若出现出价相同的情况，则通过均匀随机方式决定胜出者。如果所有智能体的出价均为零，则没有智能体执行行动，该回合将被跳过。

paragraphs.en: Training Setup. All agents have independent model parameters and undergo a supervised fine-tuning (SFT) cold start before post-training. paragraphs.en: Figure 5 compares MPT with monolithic RL under matched training FLOP budgets across three tasks. All methods are compared under matched training FLOPs, which count all LLM computation during training, including bid generation by all N N agents, action generation, counterfactual rollouts, and parameter updates. In embodied crafting, MPT achieves a final mean episode reward of approximately 41, compared with 20 for the monolithic baseline. In robot navigation, MPT maintains substantially higher rewards after the initial training phase, ending at approximately 0.9 versus 0.3 for the baseline. In deep research, MPT improves mean accuracy to approximately 27%, whereas the monolithic baseline reaches about 6%. Qualitative case studies are provided in Appendix C .

sents.en: Figure 6 plots the participation proportions of the Logger, Miner, and Smith against decision step.
sents.zh: 图6展示了记录员、矿工和锻造工在不同决策步骤中的参与比例。

paragraphs.en: Before RL, the Logger dominates throughout the episode, while the Miner and Smith participate infrequently. As training progresses, this pattern changes: the Logger remains predominant at early steps, but its share decreases later as the Miner and Smith become more involved. This shift becomes more pronounced after RL, with the Miner approaching the Logger’s participation level toward the end of the episode. At decision step 120, the Logger’s participation share decreases from approximately 80% before RL to 45% after RL, while the Miner’s share increases from approximately 10% to 40%. The Smith’s share also increases from approximately 10% to 15%. These observations provide behavioral evidence that the swarm adapts its allocation of acting turns during training.
paragraphs.zh: 在强化学习（RL）之前，记录者（Logger）在整个回合中占据主导地位，而采集者（Miner）和制造者（Smith）则很少参与。 随着训练的进行，这种模式发生了变化：记录者在早期步骤中仍然占主导地位，但后来其份额逐渐减少，因为采集者和制造者的参与度越来越高。 强化学习之后，这种转变变得更加明显，到回合结束时，采集者的参与度已接近记录者。 在第 120 个决策步骤中，记录者的参与份额从强化学习前的约 80% 下降到了强化学习后的 45%，而采集者的份额则从约 10% 上升到了 40%。 制造者的份额也从约 10% 增加到了 15%。 这些观察结果为群体在训练过程中调整行动回合的分配方式提供了行为证据。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we show that training effectively improves both the action policy and self-orchestration. To verify this, we examine their contributions through four inference-time configurations, independently using either the initial or post-trained checkpoints for each component. We evaluate each configuration over the same 32 seeds and report mean episode reward in Table 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们展示训练能有效提升动作策略和自我编排能力。 为验证这一点，我们通过四种推理时的配置来检验它们的贡献，其中每个组件均独立使用初始或训练后的检查点。 我们在相同的 32 个种子数据上评估每种配置，并在表 2 中报告平均回合奖励。

paragraphs.en: As shown in the table, using post-trained checkpoints for both components substantially outperforms all other configurations, whereas using a post-trained checkpoint for only bidding or only action yields smaller improvements over the initial baseline. Using post-trained checkpoints for both components yields a mean reward of 41.5, compared with 21.5 for trained bidding with initial actions and 27.2 for initial bidding with trained actions. The fully post-trained configuration achieves 2.69 times the reward of the initial configuration, which obtains 15.4. These results indicate that strong action and bidding policies are both essential for effective self-orchestration.

paragraphs.en: Decentralized agent swarms should scale at inference time. We investigate whether learned self-orchestration enables such scaling through larger agent populations. We vary the population size across 3, 6, 9, and 12 agents by using one to four copies of each trained agent. We conduct experiments on the Iron Pickaxe crafting task over 32 seeds, with three runs per seed, and evaluate pass@3 on five subtasks: Wooden Pickaxe, Stone Pickaxe, Furnace, Iron Ingot, and Iron Pickaxe. Figure 9 shows that larger populations improve performance on all subtasks. Increasing the population from 3 to 12 agents raises pass@3 from approximately 78% to 97% on Wooden Pickaxe, from 69% to 94% on Stone Pickaxe, and from 66% to 91% on Furnace. These results indicate that self-orchestration can effectively utilize additional agents to support inference-time scaling.

paragraphs.en: Another advantage of decentralized agent swarms is that they do not rely on a central agent. This can limit the impact of occasional agent unavailability, which becomes increasingly likely as the population grows. To evaluate this, we introduce agent dropout at inference time and measure the reward under dropout. We conduct experiments on the Iron Pickaxe task over 32 seeds, averaging three runs per seed. Figure 10 shows that larger populations can preserve more capability even under severe dropout. At a dropout probability of p = 0.9 p=0.9 , the 12-agent population maintains a mean episode reward of approximately 33, compared with 19 for the 3-agent population. These results suggest that additional agents provide redundancy that helps the swarm maintain its capabilities when members become unavailable.

paragraphs.en: LLM-based multi-agent systems combine role specialization, communication, and memory to support collective behavior. Generative Agents studies emergent social interactions among agents with memory and reflection ( Park et al., 2023 ) , while CAMEL explores cooperation through role-playing ( Li et al., 2023 ) . MetaGPT and ChatDev organize software development through structured workflows and specialized roles ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ) ; AutoGen and AgentVerse provide frameworks for programmable conversations and collaborative agent teams ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) . Multiagent debate improves reasoning through iterative exchange and revision of proposed answers ( Du et al., 2024 ) . Beyond manually specified workflows, GPTSwarm optimizes graph connectivity ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ) , AgentNet adapts decentralized routing through experience and evolving connections ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and Graph-of-Agents selects agents and refines responses through graph-based collaboration ( Yun et al., 2026 ) . However, these systems generally adapt interactions at inference time. MPT learns policies through weight updates, allowing agent capabilities and self-orchestration to improve together.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统结合了角色专业化、通信和记忆功能，以支持集体行为。 《生成式智能体》研究了具有记忆和反思能力的智能体之间涌现的社会互动（Park 等人，2023），而 CAMEL 则通过角色扮演探索合作（Li 等人，2023）。 MetaGPT 和 ChatDev 通过结构化的工作流程和专业化角色组织软件开发（Hong 等人，2024；Qian 等人，2024）；AutoGen 和 AgentVerse 提供了可编程对话和协作智能体团队的框架（Wu 等人，2024；Chen 等人，2024）。 多智能体辩论通过迭代交换和修订所提出的答案来改进推理能力（Du 等人，2024）。 除了手动指定的工作流程外，GPTSwarm 优化了图连接性（Zhuge 等人，2024），AgentNet 通过经验和不断演变的连接来适应去中心化的路由（Yang 等人，2025），而 Graph-of-Agents 则通过基于图的协作选择智能体并优化响应（Yun 等人，2026）。 然而，这些系统通常在推理阶段调整互动方式。 MPT 通过权重更新学习策略，使智能体的能力和自我编排能够同步提升。

paragraphs.en: Learning decentralized policies from collective feedback is a central problem in multi-agent reinforcement learning. MADDPG and MAPPO use centralized training with decentralized execution ( Lowe et al., 2017 ; Yu et al., 2022 ) , while VDN and QMIX factorize team value functions into agent-level utilities ( Sunehag et al., 2018 ; Rashid et al., 2020 ) . COMA addresses credit assignment through a counterfactual baseline that marginalizes one agent’s action while holding the others fixed ( Foerster et al., 2018 ) . Coordination is also learned explicitly: RIAL and DIAL learn communication protocols ( Foerster et al., 2016 ) , CommNet jointly learns continuous communication and control ( Sukhbaatar et al., 2016 ) , and IC3Net learns when agents should communicate ( Singh et al., 2019 ) . Recent work extends multi-agent training to LLMs: Multiagent Finetuning updates specialized models using their own interaction data ( Subramaniam et al., 2025 ) ; Dr. MAS stabilizes reinforcement learning through agent-wise advantage normalization ( Feng et al., 2026 ) ; and CoLLM studies centralized and decentralized critics for training decentralized LLM collaborators ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . However, these methods do not connect the choice of the next agent with how downstream reward is distributed across agents. MPT couples turn allocation and credit assignment through learned bids, using task feedback to jointly improve participation and policies.
paragraphs.zh: 从集体反馈中学习去中心化策略是多智能体强化学习中的一个核心问题。 MADDPG 和 MAPPO 采用集中式训练与去中心化执行（Lowe 等，2017；Yu 等，2022），而 VDN 和 QMIX 则将团队价值函数分解为各智能体层面的效用（Sunehag 等，2018；Rashid 等，2020）。 COMA 通过一种反事实基线来解决信用分配问题：该基线在固定其他智能体动作的同时，对某一智能体的动作进行边缘化处理（Foerster 等，2018）。 协作能力也被显式地学习：RIAL 和 DIAL 学习通信协议（Foerster 等，2016），CommNet 联合学习连续通信与控制（Sukhbaatar 等，2016），而 IC3Net 则学习智能体何时应当进行通信（Singh 等，2019）。 近期的研究将多智能体训练扩展到了大语言模型：Multiagent Finetuning 利用各模型自身的交互数据来更新其专用模型（Subramaniam 等，2025）；Dr. MAS 通过按智能体归一化优势值来稳定强化学习过程（Feng 等，2026）；而 CoLLM 则研究了用于训练去中心化大语言模型协作者的集中式与去中心化批评器（Liu 等，2026）。 然而，这些方法并未将下一个智能体的选择与下游奖励如何在各智能体之间分配联系起来。 MPT 通过学习的出价机制将回合分配与信用分配耦合起来，并利用任务反馈来共同提升参与度和策略质量。

paragraphs.en: Economic coordination offers a longstanding perspective on distributed intelligence. Hayek emphasizes how prices communicate dispersed knowledge ( Hayek, 1945 ) , while Minsky describes intelligence as arising from interactions among individually limited components ( Minsky, 1986 ) . The Contract Net Protocol allocates tasks through negotiation ( Smith, 1988 ) , and market-oriented programming uses markets for decentralized resource allocation ( Wellman, 1993 ) . Economic mechanisms also connect participation to learning: Holland’s bucket brigade transfers credit along chains of active rules ( Holland, 1995 ) , and Baum’s Hayek Machine develops economic credit assignment ( Baum, 1996 ; Baum, 1999 ) . More recently, Economy of Minds uses auctions to coordinate LLM agents and guide the evolution of prompts and population with frozen model weights ( Qi et al., 2026 ) . SALE selects among agents’ proposed strategies using cost–value scoring and shared auction memory ( Alazraki et al., 2026 ) . However, recent LLM-based economic systems primarily use feedback to evolve prompts while keeping weights frozen. MPT uses feedback to train action and bidding policies, enabling agents to learn how to act and when to participate.
paragraphs.zh: 经济协调为分布式智能提供了一个长期存在的视角。 哈耶克强调价格如何传递分散的知识（Hayek，1945），而明斯基则描述智能源于个体能力有限的组件之间的相互作用（Minsky，1986）。 合同网络协议通过协商分配任务（Smith，1988），而面向市场的编程则利用市场进行去中心化的资源分配（Wellman，1993）。 经济机制还将参与与学习联系起来：霍兰德的“桶队”机制将信用沿活跃规则的链条传递（Holland，1995），而鲍姆的哈耶克机器则发展出经济信用的分配方法（Baum，1996；Baum，1999）。 近期，“心智经济”利用拍卖来协调大型语言模型智能体，并引导提示词和种群在模型权重固定的情况下演化（Qi et al.，2026）。 SALE 通过成本–价值评分和共享拍卖记忆，在智能体提出的策略中进行选择（Alazraki et al.，2026）。 然而，近期基于大型语言模型的经济系统主要利用反馈来演化提示词，同时保持模型权重固定。 MPT 利用反馈训练行动和出价策略，使智能体能够学习如何行动以及何时参与。

paragraphs.en: We introduced MPT , a framework for jointly learning individual action policies and self-orchestration in decentralized agent swarms. Learned bids connect participation decisions with local credit assignment, allowing agents to improve both how they act and when they participate without a central coordinating agent. Our experiments show benefits over monolithic post-training and other coordination strategies, while ablations demonstrate the value of learning both bidding and action policies and using learned bids for credit assignment. Trained swarms also adapt faster to related objectives, benefit from larger populations at inference time, and better tolerate agent unavailability as the population grows. These findings support treating self-orchestration as a learnable and reusable component of collective intelligence, opening a path toward decentralized agent swarms whose capabilities and organization improve together through experience.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MPT，这是一个用于在去中心化智能体群体中联合学习个体行动策略和自我协调的框架。 学习到的出价将参与决策与局部信用分配联系起来，使智能体无需中央协调智能体即可同时改进其行动方式和参与时机。 我们的实验表明，该方法相较于整体式后训练和其他协调策略更具优势，而消融研究则证明了同时学习出价和动作策略以及利用学习到的出价进行信用分配的价值。 训练后的智能体群体还能更快地适应相关目标，在推理阶段能从更大的群体规模中获益，并且随着群体规模的扩大，能更好地容忍智能体的不可用状态。 这些发现支持将自我协调视为集体智能中可学习且可重用的组件，为构建一种通过经验共同提升能力与组织结构的去中心化智能体群体开辟了道路。

paragraphs.en: To teach the models the input and output formats and establish basic task capabilities, we perform an SFT cold start in both settings. Specifically, we use Claude Sonnet 5 to generate demonstrations of crafting-task execution and record all model responses. We collect 4,791 examples from actual Minecraft interactions, including 1,677 for Logger , 2,380 for Miner , and 734 for Smith . We fine-tune the monolithic agent on the full dataset and each society agent on its corresponding subset, matching the total training compute between the two settings during cold start. SFT for each model is performed on a single B200 GPU.
paragraphs.zh: 为了让模型掌握输入和输出格式并建立基础任务能力，我们在两种设置中都执行了 SFT 冷启动。 具体来说，我们使用 Claude Sonnet 5 生成 Crafting 任务执行的演示示例，并记录模型的所有响应。 我们从实际的 Minecraft 互动中收集了 4,791 个示例，其中 Logger 有 1,677 个，Miner 有 2,380 个，Smith 有 734 个。 我们在完整数据集上对单体智能体进行微调，并为每个社会智能体在其对应的子集上进行微调，确保两种设置在冷启动阶段的总训练计算量相匹配。 每个模型的 SFT 都在单块 B200 GPU 上执行。

paragraphs.en: The task is open-domain deep research: given a question, the agent must browse a local web corpus with three tools and return a short final answer. We use the OpenResearcher benchmark ( Li et al., 2026 ) : the questions are the OpenResearcher-Dataset, and the corpus is the OpenResearcher-Corpus, served by a BM25 search service. paragraphs.en: To teach the models the input and output formats and establish basic browsing capability, we perform an SFT cold start in both settings. paragraphs.en: We walk through one evaluation episode of the trained population in which the society obtains the iron pickaxe. Figure 11 shows the cumulative reward over the episode; every marker is a decision that received a reward, coloured by the agent that won that decision’s auction. The chain unfolds in the order the tech tree requires: Logger gathers logs in the first decisions, Smith converts them into planks, a crafting table, sticks and a wooden pickaxe, Miner then takes over to dig down and mine cobblestone, Smith crafts the stone pickaxe and the furnace, Miner mines iron ore, and Smith smelts the ingots and crafts the iron pickaxe.
paragraphs.zh: 我们遍历训练后种群中的一个评估回合，在该回合中社会获得了铁镐。 图 11 展示了该回合中的累积奖励；每个标记代表一个获得奖励的决定，其颜色由赢得该决定拍卖的智能体决定。 这一过程按照技术树的要求依次展开：在最初的几个决定中，木匠收集原木，铁匠将其制成木板、制作台、木棍和木镐，随后矿工接手挖掘并开采鹅卵石，铁匠制造石镐和熔炉，矿工开采铁矿石，最后铁匠将矿石熔炼成锭并打造出铁镐。

paragraphs.en: We walk through one episode of the society on an OpenResearcher question: “Find the country where the movie ‘Legend of the Lost’ was filmed” (reference answer: Libya ). paragraphs.zh: 我们通过 OpenResearcher 的一个问题来观察社会智能体的运行过程：“找出电影《失落的传说》的拍摄国家”（参考答案：利比亚）。 社会智能体在做出 6 次决策后给出了正确答案。 表 6 列出了所有决策。 搜索器发出第一个查询。 开启器打开维基百科的搜索结果，其首段指出外景拍摄地点位于利比亚的的黎波里附近。 随后，查找器在已打开的页面中搜索国家名称，并找到了更多相关提及（莱普蒂斯·马格纳、兹利滕、加达米斯）。 接着进行了两次确认性查询，查找器最终给出了答案。

paragraphs.en: We acknowledge the following limitations:
paragraphs.zh: 我们承认存在以下局限性：

paragraphs.en: (1) MPT relies on externally evaluated task rewards to train both action and bidding policies. Its effectiveness depends on the quality of these signals. We have not evaluated settings where outcomes are primarily subjective or where reliable feedback is difficult to obtain.
paragraphs.zh: (1) MPT 依赖外部评估的任务奖励来训练动作策略和出价策略。 其有效性取决于这些信号的质量。 我们尚未评估那些结果主要具有主观性，或难以获得可靠反馈的设置。

sents.en: (1) MPT relies on externally evaluated task rewards to train both action and bidding policies.
sents.zh: (1) MPT 依赖外部评估的任务奖励来训练动作策略和出价策略。

sents.en: Its effectiveness depends on the quality of these signals.

sents.en: We have not evaluated settings where outcomes are primarily subjective or where reliable feedback is difficult to obtain.
sents.zh: 我们尚未评估那些结果主要具有主观性，或难以获得可靠反馈的设置。

paragraphs.en: (2) Bidding updates require counterfactual rollouts from the same environment and agent states. Therefore, extending this approach to irreversible real-world interactions remains an open problem.
paragraphs.zh: (2) 出价更新需要来自同一环境和智能体状态的反事实展开。 因此，将这种方法扩展到不可逆的真实世界交互仍然是一个开放问题。

paragraphs.en: (3) Despite our efforts to broaden the experimental evaluation, computational constraints limit the scale of our study. We have not explored training swarms composed of multiple models with more than 10B parameters each, or jointly training substantially larger agent populations.
